goal: Prevent CPU busy loops in network event loops caused by unhandled TCP urgent data
Ensure broken connections disconnect cleanly without bypassing receive backpressure
agreement: Supported because it fixes the busy loop issue in the P2P network layer (darosior)
Prefers always failing on wait errors rather than ignoring exceptions outside Windows (darosior)
Open question on the rationale of disconnecting directly without read readiness (darosior)
Resolved requests to extend fixes to HTTP and clarify Windows-specific checks (pinheadmz, vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because unhandled TCP urgent data can keep sockets ready and spin the event loop in a busy loop
Protects node networking threads from resource exhaustion on established connections

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because applying the socket exception handling to HTTP prevents busy loops on resets
The primary risk of resource exhaustion is on the peer-to-peer layer rather than RPC
